items.title: Albuquerque Rapid Transit Project: GABAC Bicycle Integration Presentation
items.description: Preserves the City’s 2016 GABAC briefing on Albuquerque Rapid Transit, including the proposed station network’s relationship to existing and proposed bicycle facilities, bicycle racks and eLockers, and wayfinding.

items.title: GABAC Annual Report 2018
items.description: Records GABAC’s 2018 advisory work on long-range bicycle planning, the City bike map, a bicycle coordinator, El Pueblo rail-crossing safety, downtown speed policy, bike-lane parking, and North Diversion Channel trail separation.
